description: The latest individual AI answers for the brand, newest first: the prompt, the engine, whether the brand was named and at what rank, the competitors named and the pages cited. Evidence, not a metric: never compute a rate from these; use shruwd_get_visibility, which withholds numbers below ten answers.

brandId.description: Brand id or slug, from shruwd_get_workspace, shruwd_list_brands or shruwd_create_brand. The slug is the segment in the dashboard URL (/brands/{slug}).

name: shruwd_list_answers
title: List latest answers
